mapper.select: SELECT ROOM_CLIM_FCLTY_SN, ROOM_SN, FCLTY_DIV_CD, FCLTY_CD, REG_DT, MDFCN_DT FROM ROOM_CLIM_FCLTY WHERE ROOM_SN = #{roomSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY FCLTY_DIV_CD ASC, FCLTY_CD ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ROOM_CLIM_FCLTY RC JOIN ROOM R ON R.ROOM_SN = RC.ROOM_SN AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' JOIN HOUSE H ON H.HOUSE_SN = R.HOUSE_SN AND H.PRTNR_SN = #{prtnrSn} AND H.DEL_YN = 'N' SET RC.DEL_YN = 'Y', RC.MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), RC.MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE RC.ROOM_SN = #{roomSn} AND RC.DEL_YN = 'N'
